note: THE RECORDING'S HISTORY, KEPT WHERE IT CANNOT BE MISREAD AS ITS PROVENANCE. Under the pinned
tool the differ's skew guard compares the whole provenance SET — harness_rev,
harness_rev_history, harness_rev_recorded and merged_from[].harness_rev — because one scalar
comparing equal never proved the two sides were made by the same harness. This golden was
MERGED from two parts recorded under two different revisions, so its set had three members and
could never equal a candidate recorded today, whose set has one. That is not skew anyone
chose: no cell here was recorded under a harness that is still live, and no cell's bytes
differ because of it. So the provenance was re-normalised to the ONE revision this tree
computes, and the merge history moved here — a field the tool does not read, precisely so it
documents where the cells came from without claiming to say which harness they must be
DOCUMENTATION ONLY: not one cells/*.json byte changed, and neither did the ledger, `recorded`,
